nodes.name: useMoveToOrgDialog.ts
nodes.summary: Per-surface open/close state and eligibility gate for MoveToOrgDialog, mirroring useSessionShareDialog so each mount surface (sidebar menu, chat panel menu) owns its own instance.

nodes.name: useMoveToOrgDialog
nodes.summary: Hook holding the open/close state for one MoveToOrgDialog mount surface and gating menu visibility on the user being signed into ORG2 Cloud with a pushable (non-imported) session.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable repo-scope selection control that replaces free-text repo path inputs, listing workspace repos and selecting by normalized shareable git-remote scope key rather than local path.

nodes.name: RepoScopePicker
nodes.summary: Control listing workspace repos keyed by shareable scope key, resolving async git-remote lookups for local-only entries and rendering remoteless repos disabled with an explanatory hint.

nodes.name: addressingComment.ts
nodes.summary: Pure resolver that picks the fork→comment-thread provenance source (local fork-relay registry taskContext vs. a teammate's imported wire addressesComment field) for the chat header's "Addressing comment" chip.

nodes.name: resolveAddressingComment
nodes.summary: Picks between the local fork-relay registry's taskContext and a teammate's imported wire addressesComment field to resolve the provenance shown by the "Addressing comment" header chip.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Chat-panel header contributions for the fork relay: an explicit Fork button on imported teammate sessions, a fork-provenance chip, and an addressing-comment provenance chip, bundled as one component.

nodes.name: SessionForkHeaderExtras
nodes.summary: Chat header component rendering an explicit Fork button for imported sessions plus fork-provenance and addressing-comment chips, sourced from the fork-relay registry and remote-session cache.

nodes.name: ProjectSyncChannel.ts
nodes.summary: Project/work-item collaboration sync channel bridging the Rust-side collab outbox to the backend RPC client: pulls org state deltas for local apply and drains/pushes the outbox with OCC-conflict retry-once semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a bounded push loop (max drain batches per cycle, one immediate OCC-conflict retry) to avoid turning transport batching into an unbounded throttle.

nodes.name: toRemoteEntity
nodes.summary: Converts a raw pulled project/work-item row into a typed CollabRemoteEntity for apply_remote, returning null for rows missing a valid id.

nodes.name: ProjectSyncChannel
nodes.summary: Project/work-item sync channel class: pulls the delta into local rows via the Rust bridge's applyRemote, then drains and pushes the outbox with bounded batches and one-retry OCC-conflict handling per cycle.

nodes.name: collabSyncEngineHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-agnostic teammate-session import/fork helpers plus segments push planning: consolidated remote-session import, the writable forkSession counterpart, frozen/tail event segmentation, and the shared OCC conflict matcher.
nodes.languageNotes: Large helper module (700+ lines) that is the shared backend-agnostic core reused by both the managed-cloud engine and the fork-relay completion layer.

nodes.name: deriveImportedSessionId
nodes.summary: Derives a deterministic local session id from (orgId, sourceSessionId) via SHA-256 so repeated import retries land on the same local id instead of leaking orphaned event-store entries.

nodes.name: rewriteEventsForImportedSnapshot
nodes.summary: Rewrites a batch of imported session events to carry the new local session id.

nodes.name: parseImportedSessionMetadata
nodes.summary: Legacy fallback parser for pre-M3 import provenance that was JSON-encoded into a session's error_message field.

nodes.name: findImportedSession
nodes.summary: Finds an already-imported local session matching (orgId, sourceSessionId), checking both the modern importedFrom field and the legacy error_message-encoded metadata.

nodes.name: computeFrozenEventCount
nodes.summary: Computes the length of the frozen event prefix — the longest run of leading events whose displayStatus is terminal (completed/failed) — per the segments push protocol's frozen-line rule.

nodes.name: splitFrozenIntoSegments
nodes.summary: Greedily packs frozen events into ≤256KB segments (pre-gzip), guaranteeing at least one event per segment even if oversized.

nodes.name: isCollabConflictError
nodes.summary: Detects the server's opaque OCC-conflict rejection across both the self-hosted (ORGII_CONFLICT) and managed-cloud (ORG2_CONFLICT) error message formats.

nodes.name: fetchAndAssembleSegments
nodes.summary: Fetches and reassembles a remote session's full event history from frozen + tail segments via the shared segments-fetch client, used by both import and fork.

nodes.name: importRemoteSession
nodes.summary: The consolidated teammate-session import entry point (design §7.4): fetches, dedups, and lands a remote session as a read-only local replay copy.

nodes.name: importRemoteSessionInner
nodes.summary: Internal implementation of importRemoteSession covering the assemble/dedupe/persist/atom-update pipeline for landing a remote session locally.

nodes.name: createForkedSessionId
nodes.summary: Mints a fresh local session id (`agentsession-*` prefix) for a new forked session.

nodes.name: buildForkedSessionName
nodes.summary: Builds the display name for a newly forked session derived from the source session's name.

nodes.name: forkSession
nodes.summary: Lands a teammate's replayable history as a writable local session with forkedFrom provenance, resolving the model fallback and persisting the durably cached events.

nodes.name: projectSyncBridge.ts
nodes.summary: Tauri-invoke bridge implementation for ProjectSyncChannel, isolating the Rust IPC calls (drain/ack outbox, apply remote, data-changed/outbox-flushed signals) so engine tests can mock the whole bridge in one place.

nodes.name: forkModelFallback.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves which model a forked session should run with, checking whether the original model is runnable under the forking user's own account or locally-held keys and falling back to an org-tier default otherwise.

nodes.name: isModelRunnableWithAccount
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given model can run under a specific account's key inventory (usable local key or tier-gated org model).

nodes.name: isModelRunnableLocally
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given model can run using only locally-held usable keys, independent of any account association.

nodes.name: resolveForkModel
nodes.summary: Resolves the model a forked session should run with: keeps the original model if runnable under the forking user's account/keys, otherwise falls back to an org-tier default and flags the fallback.

nodes.name: forkSession.ts
nodes.summary: Fork-relay completion layer (design §16.11) that turns an engine-level session fork into a fully dispatchable, durable local session: registers a backend agent_sessions row, arms a one-shot LLM-context handoff, and maintains a localStorage provenance registry surviving session-list reloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the batch (733 lines); combines a Zod-validated localStorage registry with an eviction cap (100 entries) and the full teammate fork action pipeline.

nodes.name: readRegistry
nodes.summary: Reads and Zod-validates the durable fork-relay localStorage registry, returning an empty registry on any parse/schema failure.

nodes.name: writeRegistryEntry
nodes.summary: Writes one entry into the fork-relay registry and evicts the oldest entries past the 100-entry cap before persisting.

nodes.name: removeForkRelayEntry
nodes.summary: Removes a session's entry from the fork-relay localStorage registry.

nodes.name: getSessionForkedFrom
nodes.summary: Reads a session's fork provenance, preferring the live Session.forkedFrom field and falling back to the durable registry after a session-list reload rebuilds the row from the backend.

nodes.name: getSessionTaskContext
nodes.summary: Reads a session's comment-task provenance from the fork-relay registry — the only local carrier of the "addressing comment" backlink.

nodes.name: resolveForkWorkspacePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a LOCAL checkout path for a fork's workspace by matching the remote record's cross-machine repoScopeKey against every locally-known repo path, avoiding dispatch into the owner's foreign absolute path.

nodes.name: requestForkSessionSetup
nodes.summary: Requests user confirmation of the fork's workspace/account/model via the ForkSessionSetupDialog request atom and awaits the resolved selection or cancellation.

nodes.name: pickMatchingCheckout
nodes.summary: Prompts the user via ForkCheckoutPickerDialog to pick a local checkout when the automatic scope-key match for a fork's source repo fails.

nodes.name: forkTeammateSession
nodes.summary: The full teammate fork action: runs the engine fork, registers a real backend agent_sessions row so the fork is dispatchable, arms the one-shot LLM-context handoff, and writes the fork-relay registry entry.

nodes.name: textValue
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text payload from a session event's content for building the handoff digest.

nodes.name: eventToHandoffItem
nodes.summary: Converts one inherited session event into a bounded digest item used to build the pending fork handoff prompt.

nodes.name: buildForkHandoffPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the bounded digest of inherited events that rides the fork's first outgoing message, giving the agent context continuity despite starting with an empty message table.

nodes.name: buildPendingForkHandoff
nodes.summary: Constructs the pending one-shot handoff record persisted in the fork-relay registry, consumed after the first send succeeds.

nodes.name: markForkHandoffConsumed
nodes.summary: Marks a fork's one-shot LLM-context handoff as consumed after the first message send succeeds, so it is not reapplied.

nodes.name: ForkCancelledError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when the user cancels a fork mid-flow (e.g. closing the checkout picker or setup dialog), used to distinguish a quiet abort from a real failure.

nodes.name: importedSessionScopeMatch.ts
nodes.summary: Filters imported (read-only replay) sessions down to those whose source repo falls inside a given org's configured repo scopes, for scope-based sidebar grouping.

nodes.name: isScopeMatchableImportedSession
nodes.summary: Type-guard predicate for imported sessions that carry a repoPath and are recognized as external-history imports, the precondition for scope matching.

nodes.name: collectScopeMatchedImportedSessionIds
nodes.summary: Filters a session list down to the ids of imported sessions whose repo falls inside a given org's configured repo scopes.
